data.description:
## Context / Problem

The production MCP tickets clone `/var/gerrit/site/mcp-tickets` holds files that fsck reports on every run:
- 23 untracked pre-compaction event files, all dated 2026-09-04 22:23:46 PDT. Each has a tracked `.retired` copy.
- 2 abandoned staging files:
  - `.tmp-event-ozn20x_n`: a SIGNATURE, uuid e5aea5b2, staged 2026-09-03.
  - `.tmp-event-5hczbnpq`: a COMPLETION_VERDICT for `bea4-b9cc-18cc-40c4`, uuid 30f74a79, staged 2026-10-23 22:37:46 PDT. It was superseded by that ticket's 22:57 PDT verdict.

The evidence is in the 2026-11-03 comments on topnotch-brazen-slug.

The operator decided to remove these files through the supported door: `rebar store maintenance` (`docs/concurrency.md`, section "The supported door"). That door cannot do it today. `--clean` (`src/rebar/_commands/tracker_maintenance.py:193-249`) acts only on 2 kinds of path:
- stranded index entries, from `git diff --diff-filter=U`;
- foreign top-level paths, from `foreign_store_path_list`.

Neither class includes untracked files inside a ticket directory or `.tmp-event-*` staging files. No runbook in `infra/runbooks/` runs the door against the server clone. `review-bot-ops.md` covers only drift checks with `docker compose exec mcp`.

`rebar store doctor --repair` quarantines only untracked SNAPSHOT and `.retired` leftovers, so it does not cover these files either.

## Decision needed (operator)

Choose one:
- extend `rebar store maintenance --clean` with a provable rule. For example: remove an untracked event file only when its tracked `.retired` copy is byte-identical at HEAD. Handle `.tmp-event-*` only with an operator-named uuid list. Also add a runbook for running the door inside the MCP container through SSM.
- authorize a different, human-run procedure.

The topnotch-brazen-slug session stopped without writing to production, because the door would need a new rule or a human-only step.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An operator records the chosen procedure on this ticket.
- [ ] [non-codebase] The server clone's MCP fsck reports 0 `tracker_dirty_tmp_event` and 0 `tracker_dirty_untracked_event`, and no `snapshot_inconsistent` / `orphan_event` row from those files. A backup ref is named on this ticket.
data.title: Server clone leftover event files need a maintenance-door rule to remove
